segments.name: Pressure Control
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, sells and rents wellhead and pressure control equipment and frac rental equipment for onshore oil and gas operators.
segments.evidence: The Pressure Control segment designs, manufactures, sells and rents a range of wellhead and pressure control equipment under the Cactus Wellhead brand.

segments.name: Spoolable Technologies
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells spoolable pipe and end fittings used as production, gathering and takeaway pipelines by oil and gas operators.
segments.evidence: The Spoolable Technologies segment designs, manufactures, and sells spoolable pipe and associated end fittings under the FlexSteel brand.

revenueModel.text: Oil and gas operators pay for product sales, rentals, and installation and other field services on their wells.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues are derived from three sources: products, rentals, and field service and other.

changes.text: In 2023 the company acquired the FlexSteel business, adding the Spoolable Technologies segment.
changes.evidence: On February 28, 2023, we completed the acquisition of the FlexSteel business
